Name: AT Obelisk Japanese Tea Garden
Author: GustionPlayz
Description:
[color=#ffff00][size=4][b]Description[/b][/size][/color]
   I made this version because I wanted to combine 2 Content Patcher (CP) mods
- (CP) texture farm buildings [including Obelisks], with
- (CP) Obelisk Japanese Tea Garden mod.
   Using 2 Content Patcher Obelisk textures mod would make it look broken. So, Alternative Texture can solve this problem.

[color=#ff0000][size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size][/color]
[color=#d4d4d8]You will need [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alternative Textures[/url] to use this mod.[/color]

[color=#d4d4d8]• [i]Optional :[/i][/color]
[color=#d4d4d8][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/37145]Hide Building Shadows[/url] to hide the shadows of buildings (including the Obelisk) that look unrealistic with this mod[/color]

[color=#00ff00][size=4][b]Real Owner[/b][/size][/color]
Big thanks to the real owner [NasikaSakura] who made this mod, I really like [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14078]This Mod[/url] and used it on my first smapi farm.
